name: lx_dsh_peek
description: Read-only, no-input, light-themed LAN peek at active DSH sessions, plus host-injected font and full-pane conversation-width overrides for the official DSH UI (no patched DMG). Live reasoning with incremental delta rendering and reconnect baseline hydration, background-command output, animated running state, tail-only panes with hidden scrollbars, one multiplexed SSE with heartbeat recovery, subagent-aware follow, live turn/end dismissal with a black/white completion flash, screen-wake fallback, 1/2/3/4 panes and orientation-aware layout.
author: llp
